workspacePage.title: Engineering Standards
workspacePage.content:
## Code Review Guidelines

1. All PRs require at least 1 approval
2. Tests must pass before merge
3. No direct commits to main
4. Use conventional commits
5. Document public APIs

workspacePage.title: Architecture Decisions
workspacePage.content:
## ADR-001: Database Selection

**Status**: Accepted

We chose SQLite for the initial release due to zero-config deployment and sufficient performance for single-tenant use.

## ADR-002: State Management

**Status**: Accepted

Zustand for client state, TanStack Query for server state.

supportTicket.subject: Unable to export reports to PDF
supportTicket.description: When clicking "Export to PDF" in the Reports module, nothing happens. No error shown. Using Chrome 120 on macOS.

supportTicket.subject: Invoice shows incorrect tax calculation
supportTicket.description: Invoice #INV-2024-045 shows 8.5% tax instead of 10%. The subtotal is correct but the tax line is wrong.

supportTicket.subject: Feature request: Dark mode for reports
supportTicket.description: It would be great if the reports module supported dark mode. Currently the charts are hard to read in dark theme.

supportTicket.subject: Login page crashes on Safari mobile
supportTicket.description: The login page shows a blank white screen on Safari for iOS 17. Reproducible on iPhone 15 Pro.

supportTicket.subject: Need to add custom fields to contacts
supportTicket.description: We need to add custom fields like "Account Tier" and "Contract Renewal Date" to contact records.

supportTicket.subject: Data export timeout for large datasets
supportTicket.description: When exporting more than 10,000 records, the export times out after 30 seconds.
supportTicket.resolution: Implemented chunked export with streaming. Resolved in v2.4.1.
